descriptionChirho: An assigned obligation, responsibility, or service duty, especially the Levitical charge of guarding or maintaining the tabernacle/temple and its furnishings.
A temporal division of guard duty or priestly service; a scheduled turn or roster in which groups rotate their responsibilities.
The physical location or station where a guard or watchman stands to keep watch.
A divine charge, commandment, or ordinance entrusted by God to be observed and kept.
The act of keeping something in protective custody or safekeeping, including confinement or storage under guard.
Concrete persons who serve as guards or sentries, a metonymic extension from the duty to the people performing it.
